subject: Kickoff: COMISR for user-upload enhancement
body:
Hi Bao,

Kicking off compression-informed video super-resolution for the efficiency portfolio. Base is our open-source COMISR work: super-resolution built for compressed video, which matters because real user uploads arrive as CRF-compressed streams, not pristine frames — models trained on clean inputs fall apart there.

Product target: an enhancement pass for user-uploaded video on the serving side. Half plan: reproduce the vid4 evaluation on our stack by mid-April, extend the compression matrix beyond CRF25 in May, code-complete by end of May with a Shipyard demo after Launch Review Board.

Compute should be modest; the model is small by current standards. Staffing plan by 3/9? Note we have five people attached, so I mostly need clarity on fractions and who owns eval vs deployment.

Zofia
